dialogues.speaker: Top Flying Scores
dialogues.text: Top Flying Scorer — Matahga

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, so this is what we're looking for — something with red in it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Huh? The stuff we threw in is gone... We did chuck something in, right? Something doesn't feel quite right here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there something else in the jar?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Knock on the jar)

dialogues.speaker: Top Flying Scores
dialogues.text: Top Flying Scorer — Acomitl

dialogues.speaker: Top Flying Scores
dialogues.text: Top Flying Scorer — Manyoya

dialogues.speaker: Eye-Catching Slogan
dialogues.text: The Soaring Saurian is open all day! If you wish to join Matahga's special training, then come lift off from the Soaring Saurian! Note:

dialogues.speaker: Eye-Catching Slogan
dialogues.text: Up with serious, rigorous training! Down with sloth and slacking!

dialogues.speaker: Eye-Catching Slogan
dialogues.text: Laze about today, and be as trash tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Eye-Catching Slogan
dialogues.text: Only those who push forward boldly shall truly know greatness as Saurian riders!

dialogues.speaker: Matahga! Remember!!!
dialogues.text: The code is: Blow the left horn first, then the right one, then the left again, and finally the right... but blow 'em at your own peril!

dialogues.speaker: Matahga! Remember!!!
dialogues.text: Feeding a Saurian some Fowl is the best way to keep one in a good mood and avoid getting pecked!

dialogues.speaker: Matahga! Remember!!!
dialogues.text: (Seems like a reminder that someone called Matahga left for themselves. You can feel the intensity of the emotion in their words.)

dialogues.speaker: Matahga! Remember!!!
dialogues.text: (But surely putting exclamation marks at the end of every reminder is the same as putting none... Isn't it?)

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...By the order of the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, and the most benevolent and glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign, His Ma{RUBY#[D]Kalomte}jesty Och-Kan, labor is now being recruited from all tribes for the construction of water conservation infrastructure..."

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...No fixed quotas, with all being based on voluntary participation... Building the alliance... We hope all tribes will actively respond..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "By the order of the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, and the most benevolent and glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign, His Ma{RUBY#[D]Kalomte}jesty Och-Kan, the cursed land is hereby sealed off, effective immediately. All members of the alliance are strictly prohibited from entering."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Those who enter without authorization will be officially recognized as enemies of the alliance. This is the joint declaration of (...) Nanatzcayan, Meztli, Huitztlan, and Teteocan."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Glory forever unto to the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, the Great Pe{RUBY#[D]Q'atal Tzij}acemaker the most benevolent Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign Och-Kan."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Given the slow overall progress of the drainage works in this area, minor adjustments are being made to the rotation system to ensure the alliance's inexorable triumph."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Workers will be divided into three teams, each team working sixteen hours, rotating every two days. Teams with exceptional performance will receive extra grain provisions."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "The triumphant victory of <color=#00E1FFFF>draining the accumulated water</color> is close at hand. Once the ditches are completed, the <color=#00E1FFFF>water pump</color> can operate normally. Push a little harder!"

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...Compatriots, family, brothers and sisters who have dedicated themselves to the alliance's inexorable triumph..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...The most benevolent... has allocated a batch of new mechanisms from (...) to support transportation, (...) and <color=#00E1FFFF>underwater salvage</color>..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...Forward! Forward! Move forward at all costs... For the glorious future of the alliance, for our freedom and glory, for a homeland free from the evil dragons's oppression..."

dialogues.speaker: Vaguely-Readable Writings
dialogues.text: "...Without permission... it is forbidden to operate the <color=#00E1FFFF>control lever</color>... Accidental falls... have already caused the deaths of three workers..."

dialogues.speaker: Artisan's Memo (I)
dialogues.text: "...There's a small trail behind a stone wall to the north that leads to the top of the waterfall. It can be used as a <color=#00E1FFFF>storage area</color>..."

dialogues.speaker: Artisan's Memo (I)
dialogues.text: "...I left a few marks, just in case I forget the way later..."

dialogues.speaker: Artisan's Memo (I)
dialogues.text: "...Sayani's injuries took a turn for the worse. The humidity's to blame... I told her to rest, but she laughed it off... saying it would slow the squad down, resulting in everyone missing out on extra provisions..."

dialogues.speaker: Artisan's Memo (I)
dialogues.text: "...Once night falls, I'll sneak up to her with a torch to cauterize her wound while the others aren't watching, or her limbs will rot, too..."

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...May glory eternal be... Peacemaker... Most benevolent... Och-Kan..."

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Bulletin
dialogues.text: ...Artisans Mahutzintl, Tlanalco, and... those responsible for the construction of the water pump... deliberately slowed down, causing delays... The benevolent... imposed no punishment... only suspended rations for three weeks...

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Bulletin
dialogues.text: "...The <color=#00E1FFFF>stone key</color> that activates the <color=#00E1FFFF>water pump mechanism</color>... is kept at... no one is allowed to use it without permission... until other artisans are assigned..."

dialogues.speaker: "Lavender Flower"
dialogues.text: (A romance novel written by Dorothy Leeckson. On its faded cover, a woman lies on a bed surrounded by flowers.)

dialogues.speaker: "Lavender Flower"
dialogues.text: (After skimming through the book, you feel warm and content, but haven't gained any useful insights.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Was it her family's gardener or her best friend's cousin's brother-in-law?... Ugh, Paimon's head hurts!

dialogues.speaker: "Detective Snowpaws"
dialogues.text: (The biography of Frank Drebin, retired Inspector of Fontaine's Marechaussee Phantom special police force. Yep, the Inspector is a vigorous white cat.)

dialogues.speaker: "Detective Snowpaws"
dialogues.text: (A big cat paw print is imprinted on the title page of this book, perhaps a special memento the Inspector has left for his subordinates.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously... Might as well write a book about Paimon too, called... The White-Haired Detective!

dialogues.speaker: "History of Teyvat: Part I"
dialogues.text: (A work by Fontainian playwright, Jean Brooklyn. A book this thick can totally be used by shorter people to increase their height.)

dialogues.speaker: "Fontainian Perfume Ad Collection"
dialogues.text: (A photo album that doesn't seem rather popular. It's filled with images of beautiful young ladies.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph... Just pictures of girls? Boring!

dialogues.speaker: Holy Sovereign's Notes (IV)
dialogues.text: "...The secret... necessary sacrifices... anything it takes..."

dialogues.speaker: Holy Sovereign's Notes (IV)
dialogues.text: (Most of the rest of the content has been burned and is illegible.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On closer inspection, it does seem odd that the only empty jar is the one in front of this Monetoo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did the other Monetoo find what they were looking for but this one didn't?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Poor thing... C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's help it find the stuff that was meant to fit in this jar... Hmm. What would that be, though?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Place)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm, this doesn't look to be the right thing...

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: (Childish, scribbled writings are visible:)

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: This game's called "Bing Bong Ding Dong," and here's the rules:

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: 1. When the Bing Bong Monetoo isn't ding-donging, ride on the Saurian statue's back to make it move forward.

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: 2. Get off the Saurian statue when the Bing Bong Monetoo counts down to a "ding!" or you'll lose.

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: 3. First one to run to the Bing Bong Monetoo wins!

dialogues.speaker: A Child's Notes
dialogues.text: And don't give me that "isn't this just Red Light, Green Light?" crap. Rules are important, and it's precisely because you don't respect the rules that you can't win!
